environment: Disposable loopback PostgreSQL; SMS/refund mocks; no AI calls

tests.name: backfill dry-run preserves data, apply reconstructs legacy on_hand and rerun is idempotent
unpaid hold preserves on_hand and expiry restores availability
true concurrent race for last unit admits one order
same idempotency key returns one order and rejects changed payload
late verified payment re-reserves available stock
mismatched verified amount or order identity never consumes inventory
late verified payment without stock creates one mock refund, notification and ticket
late card receipt without stock is rejected with manual-review ticket
cancellation releases rather than expires and is idempotent
one active order per phone or IP and five reservations per hour
two expiry workers release once; dry-run leaves stock untouched
OTP is hashed, single-use, five-attempt locked and guest without proof is rejected
database prevents negative stock and audit modification
public product reads lazily expire stock and rollout fallback never uses permanent deductions
